title: coordkit message envelope
description: Logical direct-delivery message between live sessions. The current bus still flattens messages into inbox files for delivery, but the protocol shape is defined here so message semantics do not remain an implementation detail.

schema_version.description: Envelope version. Missing values default to 1.0.

id.description: Unique message id for delivery and deduplication.

kind.description: Targeting mode used by the bus.

value.description: Target value for the selected kind, or empty for all.

body.description: Message text to inject into the target session's next turn.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the message was enqueued, for display and diagnostics.

delivery.description: Delivery state used by the runtime projection.
